limitations: One ordinary authenticated observation; not averages, p95, global proof or a controlled before/after comparison.
Provider request is non-streaming. Before-headers wait includes network travel, provider queueing and processing; these are not separated.
First observed body bytes are not first generated token; first-byte span overlaps headers/body and must not be summed with them.
Body-read duration includes consumption; SDK spans are elapsed wall time, not isolated CPU measurements.
Browser duration is rounded request timing, not complete user-perceived question-to-render time.
SDK/body overhead was small in this sample; no claim that it is always small.
Exactly one paid request; billing cost unavailable.
privacy: No question, personal excerpts, account identifiers, cookies, authorization headers, provider response bodies or evidence links stored.
